# LEADEX III SUPER BRONZE PRO 750W SUPER FLOWER
URL: https://www.super-flower.com.tw/en/products/leadex-iii-bronze-750w

LEADEX III SUPER BRONZE PRO 750W SUPER FLOWER 

# LEADEX III SUPER BRONZE PRO 750W

 Please contact the distributor in your country for the availability and quotation 

 $0.00 

##### Description

LEADEX III SUPER BRONZE PRO series are 80PLUS Bronze certified and fully modular cables with ultra flexible ribbon design. An ideal to maximize PSU cable management to have the best routing solution, which also increases case chassis air flow to have best cooling for your system. Universal Super Connectors with patent allows you to plug CPU, PCI-E and peripherals freely in any of the 9pin socket provided. It provides high efficiency & stable power output and come with a 12cm two-way thermal control intelligent cooling fan to ensure your professional PC system will work under heavy load, also capable of powering your PC system equipped with NVIDIA® SLI™ or ATI CrossFireX™ setup.

♦ 100% Fully Modular With All Ultra Flexible Ribbon Cables For Easy Cable Management. ♦ Patented universal SUPER CONNECTOR for installation freely at will. ♦ 20+4pin connector with patent buckle design. ♦ 80 PLUS® Bronze Certified, 82% 85% 82% Efficiency At 20% 50% 100% Rated Load ♦ Comply With Energy Star Standard & EuP (Energy Using Products) Regulation. ♦ Comply With ATX 12V v2.52, EPS 12V v2.92 Specification. ♦ Support All Intel / AMD Multi-Core CPU & ATX / BTX Compatible Motherboards. ♦ Over Voltage Protection / Over Current Protection / Over Power Protection / Short Circuit Protection / Under Voltage Protection / Over Temperature Protection / Low Voltage Protection / No Load Operation / Surge & Inrush Protection. ♦ Support NVIDIA® SLI™ & ATI CrossFireX™ High Performance Graphic Card. ♦ More than 2,000 times On/Off test. ♦ Lead-Free Green Materials with RoHS / WEEE Compliance. ♦ Full Range Auto Voltage Detection Design from 100V ~ 240V (Active PFC). ♦ PCI-E (6+2) Pin Connector For High-End Graphic Card Requirement. ♦ Japanese 105°C Main Capacitor. ♦ LLC Resonant Converter With DC-DC Platform. ♦ ECO Intelligent Thermal Control System. 1. Auto & ECO Fan control 2. High efficiency on all rails, including 5VSB
